provenance: Massing is AUTHORED and is not a measurement. Plans, positions and orientations are measured (OpenStreetMap, ODbL 1.0) and are never modified by this file. Heights are cited facts, sourced per landmark below. A render of these landmarks must never be offered as evidence for a number.
note: Each recipe supplies only what OSM cannot express: the vertical profile. 461 of the 520 buildings over 100 m in this window have no building:part record, and a live Overpass query returns zero parts for the Burj Al Arab, so no re-fetch would ever produce a sail.

landmarks.formNote: Crest profile and orientation are a LOOK CHOICE, not a measurement. Three derivations were tried and rejected: tapering both axes gave a cone; a roofline driven by the measured plan width gave a central spike, because the plan is a crescent widest in the middle and its width does not track its height; and neither the shoreline nor the width profile identifies which end is high, since the building runs along the beach rather than into it. Set flip=true if someone with a reference says otherwise.
